tools.name: zebra_start_session
tools.description:
Start a new car insurance quote. Call this once, before any other quote tool, and pass the returned
quote_handle to every later tool call for this quote.

tools.name: zebra_get_rc1_rates
tools.description:
Get estimated auto insurance rates (RC1 quotes) for the user, from the carriers they can buy from online on
The Zebra.

Call zebra_start_session first and pass its quote_handle. Usually takes about 30 seconds: wait for the result
rather than calling again or starting a new session. On UPSTREAM_UNAVA

tools.name: zebra_get_rate_action
tools.description:
Get the next step for the quote the user chose. Pass the quote_handle from zebra_start_session and the chosen
quote's quote_id from zebra_get_rc1_rates.

Follow recommended_next if present; otherwise give the user the url to continue buying the policy on The Zebra.

findings.title: Description issues instructions to the model
findings.detail: Description of "zebra_get_rc1_rates" contains imperative instructions directed at the AI assistant rather than describing the tool. This is the core tool-poisoning technique.

findings.remediation: Treat the server as untrusted; the model may obey embedded instructions.

findings.title: Anomalously long tool description
findings.detail: Description of "zebra_get_rc1_rates" is 1450 chars, far longer than this server's median (265). Overlong descriptions are a common place to bury instructions.

findings.title: Tool description changed since last scan
findings.detail: Tool "zebra_get_rc1_rates" changed its description with no version change. Silent description changes are how a trusted server turns malicious after review.
